name: net.unfret/mcp
title: Unfret
description: Checks a store, marketplace seller or listing for scam signals before an agent buys, paid per check

environmentVariables.name: UNFRET_PASS
environmentVariables.description: An Unfret pass (ufk_...) to pay checks from instead of a wallet: quick checks free, deep checks one of the pass's checks

environmentVariables.name: UNFRET_MCP_KEYPAIR
environmentVariables.description: Path to the agent's Solana CLI keypair JSON, the wallet that pays for checks (or set UNFRET_MCP_SECRET_KEY); not needed with UNFRET_PASS or UNFRET_MCP_BASE_KEY

environmentVariables.name: UNFRET_MCP_MAX_PRICE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Refuse any single check worth more than this many dollars

environmentVariables.name: UNFRET_MCP_SESSION_CAP_USD
environmentVariables.description: Refuse once the session has spent this many dollars

environmentVariables.name: UNFRET_MCP_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: solana-mainnet, or solana-devnet together with UNFRET_API_URL=https://dev.unfret.net

environmentVariables.name: UNFRET_MCP_BASE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The agent's EVM private key (hex), to pay checks in USDC on Base; never logged

environmentVariables.name: UNFRET_MCP_BASE_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: base-mainnet (real USDC on unfret.net), or base-sepolia (test USDC) together with UNFRET_API_URL=https://dev.unfret.net; only this network is paid

environmentVariables.name: UNFRET_MCP_PREFER
environmentVariables.description: With both a Solana and a Base wallet, the network tried first; the other is the fallback

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Your Unfret pass as a bearer token (a developer pass with free checks: https://unfret.net/developers)
